title: Purge Hardcoded Developer Paths, Dynamic Board Gatekeeper Skip, and Modern Pwsh Support
commitMessage: feat(core): purge hardcoded developer paths, support dynamic board gatekeeper skip, and enable modern pwsh in hooks
author: tauri-rust-engineer
summary: Eliminated hardcoded fallback path C:\Users\Voimax\Projects\CanbanVoimaxHarness in config.rs to rely strictly on active project file (%LOCALAPPDATA%), directory traversal (.cvh / .git), and current_dir. Generalized gatekeeper sensor bypass on initial card transitions in tasks.rs to dynamically check if the target stage is the active board's first actionable (non-backlog) column (e.g. concept for 3D modeler, triage for QA). Added cross-platform modern pwsh detection and execution in hooks.rs with fallback to legacy powershell.exe on Windows, accompanied by unit testing.
